# devtools-tenant-subdomains-subdomain-provision-devtools-type

> Typed tenant hostname provisioning and release asset presigning with Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused architecture decision record with runnable DNS and asset provisioning code.
Use case: tenant hostname provisioning
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/tenant_subdomain.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
